purpose: Agency identity/capacity tranche spanning counter-evidence, armed-forces incident boundaries, municipal project scope and source-producing provenance without agency-wide inheritance.
migrationRule: An Agency counts as migrated only when its ABox record points to a dedicated Agency dossier. Formal mandate, armed-forces identity, municipal project naming and evidence production do not create Material Participation or governance inheritance.
visualRule: Derived visuals show State context and the curated agency proposition, then stop at identity. Source production, counter-evidence, incident acknowledgment and municipal naming do not propagate governance.
